description: A Lifetime of Service. A Record of Integrity. Justice Clarissa Silva was born and raised in Harlingen, Texas, where she learned the values of faith, hard work, and service to others. Growing up, her family taught her the importance of helping people without expecting anything in return—an outlook that continues to guide her public service…
